fderoles.why: Sorting real tasks into the role that owns them makes the differences stick; the reading explains the lifecycle and titles.

fdeskills.why: Rating yourself on a live radar makes gaps visible; the reading explains each axis and how to turn gaps into a route.

asyncwriting.why: Writing improves by rewriting real messages; a checker that flags a missing ask, owner or deadline gives instant feedback.

ethics.why: Working through realistic dilemmas and seeing the reasoning builds judgement; the reading gives the rules behind each choice.
